limitations: Registration counts include soldiers, civilians, speakers, multiplayer and aliases; they are not enemy counts.
Conditional source declarations are possible facts, not guaranteed effective template values.
Difficulty variants, randomized stats, DLC/mod hooks and native changes are not executed.
Config-backed stats, damage, loadout contents and AI behavior trees remain unresolved; explicit source overrides are listed separately.
Only literal ability/weapon definition names are indexed; empty definition_sources do not prove that an ability is missing.
The catalog is source metadata, not live hidden enemy state and not an input that reveals hidden contacts to the tactical planner.
Values are from the supplied game Default INIs, not the effective runtime/mod/DLC load order.
SDK Defaults corroborate files only; SDK-generated XCom INIs never override game values.
Difficulty values inherit known base entries and apply explicit partial difficulty overrides.
Missing sections, keys and array indexes are unknown; explicit zero remains zero.
Native class defaults, randomized values, source assignments and hooks may change runtime stats.
Legacy or unsupported enum keys are retained as config declarations, not certified native stat slots.
AI root children are an index, not an execution trace or prediction of private enemy intent.
